personality_one_liner: A cinematic, elegant, and peaceful digital tasbih built with deep emerald, navy, and soft gold accents, emphasizing spiritual focus and premium craftsmanship.

spacing.rule: Generous, breathing vertical rhythm. Central elements should have ample negative space to emphasize focus and calmness.

do's: Use frosted glass (expo-blur) for the bottom tab bar and floating action controls.
Apply subtle glass overlays on Dhikr cards to give them a premium, layered feel.
Use glass headers when content scrolls behind them.
dont's: Do not blur the main counter area; it must remain hyper-readable.
Do not overuse blur on dense text areas like the Esmaül Hüsna lists.

screens.name: Splash & Onboarding
screens.purpose: Set a peaceful, premium tone with the slogan 'Her Dokunuşta Huzur'.

states.loading: Fade in gold logo on dark emerald/navy gradient background

screens.layout: Full screen dark emerald-to-navy background. Gold logo (Cormorant Garamond) centered. 3-step onboarding using full-bleed dark abstract imagery with gradient-to-dark scrim, large gold serif headings, and a sticky glass CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Home (Ana Sayfa)
screens.purpose: The main dhikr counter. Must be readable, distraction-free, and one-handed.
screens.layout: Almost the entire screen acts as a touchable area (flex: 1). Large, elegant serif counter (~120pt) vertically and horizontally centered. Wrapped in a subtle, animated circular ring (simulating tasbih beads). Top: Current Dhikr name and target progress (e.g., 24/33). Bottom right/left: Floating glass pills for Undo, Reset, Sound, and Vibrate toggles.

screens.name: Zikirlerim & Namaz Sonrası Tesbihat
screens.purpose: List of ready dhikrs and the auto-transitioning post-prayer mode.

states.empty: Elegant illustration of a tasbih with text 'Henüz özel zikir eklenmedi'.

screens.layout: Top section: A featured, large glass card for 'Namaz Sonrası Tesbihat' (33x3 auto transition mode) with a rich emerald gradient. Below: A 2-column or list layout of ready dhikrs (Sübhanallah, Elhamdülillah, vb.) showing Arabic and Turkish titles. Floating '+' button (FAB) in gold for custom dhikrs.

screens.name: Esmaül Hüsna
screens.purpose: Beautifully formatted 99 Names of Allah with meanings and individual counters.
screens.layout: List view. Each row has a circular index/number, the Name in Arabic (elegant serif), Turkish spelling, and a brief meaning. Tapping a row opens a bottom sheet with a dedicated counter for that specific Name.

screens.name: İstatistikler (Stats)
screens.purpose: Track daily, weekly, and all-time dhikr progress.
screens.layout: Top half: A sleek, dark dashboard with gold accent numbers showing total counts and streaks. Bottom half: A bar chart (using simple view widths or a lightweight SVG) showing the last 7 days of activity.

screens.name: Ayarlar (Settings)
screens.purpose: App preferences including theme, haptics, and accessibility.
screens.layout: Standard list layout with glass rows. Toggles for Sound, Vibration, Big Text Mode, Simple Mode, and Light/Dark Theme override.

onboarding_bg_1.alt: Dark geometric dome with gold calligraphy

instructions_to_main_agent: Design entirely using the 'Glass / Luxe DARK' personality. The background should be a deeply rich dark navy/emerald tone (#06090E to #0D2B1D) with striking soft gold accents (#C6A664).
CRITICAL: The Home screen's counter MUST be the dominant element. Use a massive font size (~120pt) with the Cormorant Garamond serif font to evoke a premium Islamic calligraphy feel.
Make the entire background of the Home screen act as a massive touch target (`Pressable` with `flex: 1`). Do not restrict the tapping area to a small button.
Ensure 'Namaz Sonrası Tesbihat' mode functions by auto-transitioning to the next phrase when the count reaches 33. The UI should smoothly indicate this shift.
Implement light haptics on every counter tap, and a 'success' haptic when a target (33, 99, etc.) is reached.
For the Esmaül Hüsna list, use elegant typography. Show Arabic script prominently alongside the Turkish meaning. Ensure the text isn't cramped.
Use `expo-linear-gradient` to create a soft, rich emerald-to-navy fade on featured cards and the splash screen.
Always apply a gradient-to-dark scrim over background images (like in onboarding) to ensure text readability.
Do not use generic blue/purple AI colors. Stick strictly to the defined Emerald, Navy, Black, and Gold palette.
